text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [When Moving] [On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1level 4 or lower [Ice-Snow], [Mineral] or [Rock] trait card from your hand or trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, until your opponent's turn ends, their effects can't return 1 of your [Ice-Snow], [Mineral] or [Rock] trait Digimon to hands or decks or affect it with ＜De-Digivolve＞ effects. (Rule) Trait: Has [Mineral] Type.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
